leaf_query: What are the specific pre-market and post-market obligations under the AI Act for the non-EU manufacturer/provider, the EU importer, the EU distributor, and the healthcare organisation deploying the system, distinguishing obligations before placement on the market from those continuing after deployment?
contextual_facts: Non-EU manufacturer sells AI-enabled medical device through EU distributor
Device continuously collects biometric and health data
Cloud-hosted ML model makes treatment recommendations
Manufacturer uses collected data to improve later model versions
Device placed on EU market after AI Act provisions become applicable
Manufacturer established outside the EU sells an AI-enabled medical device through an EU distributor.
Device continuously collects biometric and health data.
Device uses a cloud-hosted machine-learning model to make treatment recommendations.
Device periodically receives model updates after deployment.
Manufacturer uses some collected data to improve later versions of the model.
Device is placed on the EU market after relevant AI Act provisions become applicable.
